newsitem.title: UK: Soros backs LCI bid for casino rival -paper.
newsitem.headline: Soros backs LCI bid for casino rival -paper.

text.p: U.S. investor George Soros is backing London Clubs International 's 200 million stg ($323.2 million) hostile bid for rival casino group Capital Corporation, the Financial Times said on Thursday.
Quantum Partners LDC, Soros's investment vehicle emerged as the only major shareholder to accept London Clubs' all-shares bid ahead of the first closing date, the FT said.
London Clubs said it had secured support from shareholders equivalent to 2.9 percent of Capital's share capital, with Quantum supplying 2.7 percent of the votes, the paper said.
